title: Fragments of Truth
next_chapter_hook: When the voice spanning ten thousand years finally revealed Chen Ji's true identity, it took him a full three hours to barely digest one fact—he had never truly lived, he was merely a manufactured tool.

text.content:
A scalding heat radiated from his palm. This page was no ordinary object—the flowing patterns on its surface closely resembled the Tianji Record fragments, yet carried an unmistakably different aura—older, more majestic, as if bearing some will beyond mortal comprehension.

Chen Ji sat up abruptly, finding himself still in that dark stone chamber. The vague outline he had sensed earlier had completely vanished, replaced by a phenomenon of the Tianji Record fragments trembling violently. All ten fragments glowed with golden light simultaneously, resonating with each other as if welcoming long-lost kin.

dialogue.content:
This page... does not belong within the original Tianji Record system.

(He gazed at the page in his hand, his fingertips lightly tracing those unfamiliar patterns, and a desolate stream of information instantly flooded his Mental Sea.)

Who concealed it deep within my consciousness?

text.content:
At this moment, the light spot formed by Mo Xiansheng's residual soul suddenly flew out from the first page of the Tianji Record, condensing into a phantom figure before Chen Ji. That aged voice rang out, yet for the first time carried an unmistakable tremor:

"You have finally touched it... the 'Original Page.'"

Mo Xiansheng's gaze fell upon the newly obtained page, his expression complex beyond measure. "This is the dwelling place of the last trace of will left by that person ten thousand years ago, and also... the true origin of the Tianji Record."

dialogue.content:
"The Original Page?"

(Chen Ji frowned, slowly unfurling that page. Upon it was not textual records, but a blurred image—countless points of light arranged like stars, vaguely forming the雏形 of some formation.)

"This page records the core formation eye of the 'Myriad Spirits Returning to Origin Array.'" Mo Xiansheng's voice dropped to an extremely low tone, "And your Chen family bloodline... is one of the keys to this formation eye."

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

He recalled the warmth of his mother's hands gripping his as she lay dying, remembered the murmured words of that woman whose face had never been clear in his memory—"You are the chosen one." At the time, he had dismissed it as the ravings of someone consumed by illness; now, every word proved prophetic.

The temperature within the stone chamber seemed to plummet several degrees. The ten Tianji Record fragments simultaneously levitated, slowly orbiting around Chen Ji. The golden light grew increasingly brilliant, finally converging into a phantom image before Chen Ji's eyes.

That was the scene from ten thousand years ago.

Countless cultivators lay upon the altar, their bloodlines extracted one by one and injected into a formation with Heavenly Dao's will as its core. The image was blurry, yet one could see the despair and unwillingness in those cultivators' eyes. And standing at the formation's very center—

His face bore a seven-tenths resemblance to Chen Ji.

"Ten thousand years ago, the Eye of Heavenly Dao intended to refine the world's fortune for its own use." Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed hauntingly, "At that time, it had not yet fully awakened and needed special bloodlines to stabilize the formation's foundation. Thus came the strategy of 'Myriad Spirits Returning to Origin'—extracting the Heavenly Fate bloodlines of eighty-one clans to refine them into its avatar."

dialogue.content:
"Eighty-one clans..."

(Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, his mind rapidly calculating the chain reactions these revelations might trigger.)

"Was the Chen family among them?"

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment before finally nodding: "Yes. And the only clan... to survive to this day."

text.content:
The image on the Original Page abruptly transformed.

That blurry figure turned around, and Chen Ji finally saw his full appearance—an middle-aged man, his brow and spirit carrying indescribable majesty and compassion. In his hand, he held a damaged scroll, precisely the雏形 of the Tianji Record.

"My name is Chen Xuan."

The aged yet familiar voice emerged from the image, causing Chen Ji to shudder. That was precisely the voice he had heard months ago within the Tianji Record ruins!

"Ten thousand years ago, I betrayed the Eye of Heavenly Dao's plan, hiding the bloodline seeds of the eighty-one clans throughout the mortal world, awaiting the day of awakening."

dialogue.content:
"Betrayed?"

(Chen Ji stared fixedly at the figure in the image, countless fragments in his mind frantically reorganizing.)

Mo Xiansheng let out a bitter laugh: "Chen Xuan was originally the spokesperson chosen by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, yet he turned against it at the critical moment. He stole the Tianji Record's core, concealed the bloodline seeds, and guarded them to this day as a remnant soul—waiting for a successor worthy of inheriting everything."

"And I..." Chen Ji lowered his gaze to his own hands, "am that successor?"

"No." Mo Xiansheng's tone abruptly turned ice-cold, "You are a vessel that was manufactured."

text.content:
These words struck like a blade, piercing directly into Chen Ji's heart.

He abruptly raised his head, only to see the image on the Original Page shifting once more—a woman lay upon a crude bed, her face deathly pale, her belly distended high. Surrounding her were dozens of complex formation patterns, forcibly channeling some golden light into the fetus within her womb.

That woman's features matched Chen Ji's memory of his mother perfectly.

dialogue.content:
"Mother..."

(Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly—this was the first time since beginning his cultivation that he displayed such obvious emotional fluctuation before another.)

Mo Xiansheng sighed: "Your mother was no ordinary person. She was the final chess piece Chen Xuan had positioned—the vessel of the 'Heavenly Fate Gestation Array.' Chen Xuan guarded her reincarnation with his remnant soul's power, solely so she could give birth to a perfect bloodline vessel."

"So... my birth was planned from the very beginning?"

choice.prompt: The truth crashed over him like monstrous waves, and Chen Ji felt his entire worldview collapsing. The "trash persona" he had constructed over seventeen years was merely the surface; his pride in his "flawless calculations" was merely a casual move on another's chessboard. At this moment, he had to make a choice—

choices.description: Since bloodline and destiny were fated long ago, rather than futile resistance, why not follow the flow and take control of this chess game myself.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Original Page permissions of the Tianji Record, enabling glimpses into deeper secrets
choices.risk_hint: Become utterly reduced to a chess piece in Heavenly Dao's game

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes.

He took a full three breaths to suppress all the churning emotions in his chest. When he opened his eyes again, those pupils had restored their usual calm and depth, as if the刚才's anguish had merely been an illusion.

"Very well."

Just one word, yet heavier than a thousand jun.

choices.description: Regardless of whatever ten-thousand-year-old schemes or bloodline vessels—Chen Ji survived to this day through his own calculations and endurance, never willing to be someone's puppet on strings.
choices.visible_cost: Experience rejection from the Tianji Record's Original Will
choices.visible_reward: Retain independent personality, but may lose part of the inheritance

text.content: "'A vessel?' Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That laughter echoed in the dim stone chamber, carrying an indescribable irony and desolation. 'I, Chen Ji, have lived for seventeen years. Every step I took was of my own making. My mother's blood debt, the humiliation of being atrash, the fortune of the Tianji Record—which one didn't I earn myself?' He suddenly clenched the Original Page, his fingertips almost embedding into the paper: 'Trying to erase all my efforts with the word "design"? Dream on!'

choices.description: Since he knew he was part of a plan from ten thousand years ago, he must make a big deal out of this identity—only those who know the secrets have the qualification to bargain with fate.
choices.visible_cost: May incur the gaze of the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Unlock "Chess Player's Perspective", allowing observation of multiple factions' schemes simultaneously
choices.risk_hint: Premature exposure may bring utter destruction
choices.process_label: calm analyze use not be used

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze flickered as countless possibilities raced through his mind. 'Mo Xiansheng.' He suddenly spoke, his voice regaining its usual composure. 'You just said that Chen Xuan betrayed the Heavenly Eye and concealed the bloodline seed. Then... where is the Heavenly Eye now?' Mo Xiansheng paused slightly, clearly not expecting him to adjust his mindset so quickly. 'It is waiting.' The old man said slowly. 'Waiting for all the chess pieces to return to their positions.'

'All chess pieces return to their positions...' Chen Ji murmured, repeating these words. His gaze suddenly fell on the other side of the Original Page. There was a line of extremely faint small characters he had previously overlooked, now finally revealed under the golden light: 'Nine times nine return to one, the wheel of fate restarts. The Chen bloodline, together march to the Yellow Springs.' Together march to the Yellow Springs. These four words made Chen Ji's heart sink heavily. He suddenly thought of his missing sister Chen Nian—that girl taken by the Holy Sect as the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.'

dialogue.content: 'Nian'er...' (Chen Ji's fingertips trembled slightly. That little girl who always followed behind him, calling out 'Brother' in her clear voice—where was she now?) Mo Xiansheng seemed to see through his thoughts, sighing: 'Your sister was not taken by coincidence. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key is the key to opening the Yellow Springs gate—and you are the only one who can awaken her.' 'So...' Chen Ji's voice dropped extremely low, 'I must find her?' 'No.' Mo Xiansheng shook his head, his tone unprecedentedly grave, 'You must save her. Because once she is fully awakened, the bloodline seed within you will also be forcibly extracted—at that time, both of you will become nourishment for the Heavenly Eye.'

text.content: A deathly silence settled over the stone chamber. Chen Ji slowly stood up, walked to the stone wall, his back to Mo Xiansheng. His shoulders trembled slightly, yet he never turned around. After a long while, he spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm: 'So, from the moment I obtained the Tianji Record, I had already stepped into a lethal trap?' 'Yes.' 'And all my efforts, all my arrangements, compared to that ultimate chess game, are nothing more than children playing house?' '...Yes.' Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That laughter was low and hoarse, carrying an indescribable weariness and self-mockery.

choice.prompt: The brutal truth lay before him—Chen Ji discovered he had been a chess piece all along, and his sister was even being used as a key to open the gate to the underworld. In this chess game destined to be lost, he must find a way to break the局面.

choices.description: One person's strength cannot oppose a ten-thousand-year layout, so borrow strength to counter force—Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, even Han Lie, anyone who can be used must be drawn to the same front.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing one's weaknesses may lead to betrayal by allies
choices.visible_reward: Gain multi-party support, strengthening leverage against the Heavenly Dao

text.content: 'Since it's a lethal trap, then break the chessboard.' Chen Ji turned around, sharp light rekindling in his eyes. He rapidly filtered usable people in his mind—Su Qingyao's sect resources, Ye Qing's Demonic Path methods, even Han Lie's brute strength, all could be variables brought into the chess game. 'Mo Xiansheng, tell me—did Chen Xuan leave any countermeasures against the Heavenly Eye back then?'

choices.text: Deeply research the nature of the bloodline
choices.description: Since he is the key, he must thoroughly understand what makes this bloodline so special—perhaps the solution lies within his own body.
choices.visible_cost: The cultivation process may trigger unforeseen consequences
choices.visible_reward: Unlock hidden bloodline abilities, greatly enhance strength
choices.risk_hint: May trigger the Heavenly Eye's alertness

text.content: Chen Ji sat cross-legged, placing the Original Page and ten pieces of the Tianji Record Fragment simultaneously in his palms. 'I want to see what this so-called 'Heavenly Fate Bloodline' truly is.' As golden light flowed, a scalding force surged from his palms into the meridians. Chen Ji closed his eyes and focused, using the Tianji Record's foresight to look inward—he saw golden specks of light sleeping within his blood, saw the sealed gate deep within his Mental Sea. On that gate was赫然刻着一个名字: Chen Xuan.

choices.text: Search for Chen Nian at all costs
choices.description: His sister is the only variable in this chess game—only by rescuing her first can he break the curse of 'together marching to the Yellow Springs.' Even if dragon's pool and tiger's den lie ahead, he must make the journey.
choices.visible_cost: Might alert the enemy and expose the action plan
choices.visible_reward: Rescue Chen Nian and gain the key to reversing fate
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect's power is immense; acting rashly means near-certain death

text.content: "Nian'er..." Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried undeniable resolve. That little girl who had always followed behind him, calling out "big brother," was now imprisoned in an unknown abyss, waiting to be sacrificed. "Master Mo, where is the Holy Sect's headquarters?" Master Mo fell silent for a moment: "Are you truly going now?" "No more waiting." Chen Ji rose, his eyes burning with killing intent. "Anyone who dares touch a single hair on my sister will have their entire clan buried."

At that moment, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly began to violently tremble. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—that was the precursor to a premonition image emerging. He didn't have time to think, immediately focusing his senses. Three breaths later, a blurry image flooded into his mind: The Holy Sect's headquarters, a certain dark underground altar. Chen Nian was chained at the formation's core, surrounded by dozens of robed cultivators. Her eyes were tightly shut, her face haggard, yet she still maintained the last thread of consciousness. And standing beside her was a figure Chen Ji knew all too well—Ling Yuan.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan in the image turned around, as if gazing across time and space directly at Chen Ji. A knowing smile curved his lips: "Chen Ji, you've finally seen." That voice pierced through the premonition, striking directly into Chen Ji's Mental Sea. Then the image abruptly shattered, leaving only the final words echoing endlessly— "The earlier you come, the faster she dies. The later you come, what I refine her into... well, that's hard to say."

text.content: Chen Ji's knuckles turned white from clenching. He slowly raised his head, looking at Master Mo, his voice terrifyingly calm: "Ling Yuan... was a piece from the very beginning?" Master Mo sighed: "Not just a piece. He is the Heaven's Eye's chosen representative in the mortal realm—when the Tianji Record skipped over him, he was already received by another force." "So he's been waiting for this day for a long time." "Yes." Master Mo said, "He's been waiting for the moment your bloodline fully awakens." Chen Ji closed his eyes. A moment later, he opened them, his gaze now utterly cold.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's threat hung over him like a sword, while his sister Chen Nian's life was clutched in that old fox's hands. Chen Ji had to make a choice within the time limit—whether to act rashly or proceed methodically?

choices.text: Endure in silence and lay out long-term plans
choices.description: The more Ling Yuan threatens, the more it shows he has reservations. Chen Ji decided to exploit this, secretly contacting Su Qingyao and Ye Qing, preparing a fatal strike when the enemy lets their guard down.
choices.visible_cost: During the waiting period, Chen Nian may suffer more torment
choices.visible_reward: A sound battle plan reduces operational risks
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may accelerate the sacrifice process

text.content: "Good." Chen Ji uttered a single word, his voice terrifyingly calm. He turned and walked to the corner of the stone chamber, taking out a communication Jade Slip and began composing a message. "Su Qingyao, Ye Qing—I have a request." The two messages were sent one after another. Chen Ji leaned against the wall, closing his eyes in contemplation. Did Ling Yuan want him to lose composure? He refused to give his enemy the satisfaction. "Let's see who loses their nerve first."

choices.text: Go immediately alone to face the enemy
choices.description: His sister's safety was more important than anything. Even if dragon's pools and tiger's lairs lay ahead, he would charge through. Even if the whole world was his enemy, he would bring Chen Nian back with his own hands.
choices.visible_cost: Going deep into enemy territory alone means extremely low odds of success
choices.visible_reward: Might rescue Chen Nian and disrupt Ling Yuan's plan
choices.risk_hint: Highly likely to fall at the Holy Sect's headquarters

text.content: "No need." Chen Ji rose, tucking the original page into his chest. His movements were calm, as if he was simply preparing for an ordinary outing. "Ling Yuan wants to see me lose composure, wants me to make mistakes. But he forgot one thing—" He raised his gaze, cold light flickering in his eyes: "I, Chen Ji, never play by the rules." The stone door crashed open. Chen Ji strode out with great steps. Behind him, Master Mo's voice drifted out: "Are you truly certain?" "Certain." Chen Ji didn't look back. "To harm my sister—you must first ask if I consent."

Outside the stone chamber, the setting sun's afterglow spread across the mountains, dyeing the pavilions and towers of the Tianqing Sect in golden crimson. Chen Ji stood on the stone steps, taking a deep breath. The churning emotions in his chest had been forcibly suppressed, replaced by unprecedented calm and resolve. He looked down at his own hands—these hands once deemed completely without talent, now carried the bloodline inheritance of ten thousand years ago, the Heavenly Secrets power of generations of prophets, and a shocking secret capable of overturning the world. "Container or piece, whatever..." He murmured to himself, the corners of his lips curving upward into a cold arc: "I, Chen Ji, am never one to be manipulated." In the distance, the majestic Holy Peak loomed faintly visible. Chen Ji clenched his fists and took the first step down the mountain.
